set_days.name: Set days
set_days.description: Marks days as day off or workday for one or more persons, or removes such exceptions. Applies to every day in the range, weekends included.

end.name: Last day
end.description: Last day of the range; same as the first day if omitted.

status.name: Status
status.description: Day off, workday, or default to remove exceptions.

set_role.name: Set role
set_role.description: Makes a person a resident, or changes the role from a date on. Earlier days keep the role they had.

role.name: Role
role.description: Pupil, adult, or none to end residency.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: First day the role applies; today if omitted.

short_name.name: Short name
short_name.description: One or two characters shown in the calendar card.

remove_role.name: Remove role step
remove_role.description: Removes a role step that was entered by mistake.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: The date of the step to remove.

set_room.name: Assign room
set_room.description: Sets the residents of a room (an area) from a date on, and/or its morning and evening rules.

person.name: Residents
person.description: Persons living in this room from the date on.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: First day the assignment applies; today if omitted.

morning_rule.name: Morning rule
morning_rule.description: How residents are combined in the morning.

evening_rule.name: Evening rule
evening_rule.description: How residents are combined in the evening.

remove_room_assignment.name: Remove room assignment step
remove_room_assignment.description: Removes an assignment step that was entered by mistake.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: The date of the step to remove.

set_order.name: Set order
set_order.description: Sets the order of residents in the calendar card.

get_days.name: Get days
get_days.description: Returns the day of every resident for whole weeks, with default, exception and reason.

start.name: Start
start.description: Any day of the first week; today if omitted.

preview_days.name: Preview days
preview_days.description: Returns how many days per person would change; writes nothing.

status.name: Status
status.description: The status that would be set.

get_overview.name: Get overview
get_overview.description: Returns all persons and areas with their roles, assignments and the state of the school holiday source.

school_holidays_unreachable.title: School holidays could not be fetched
school_holidays_unreachable.description: The source "{source}" failed {failures} times in a row. The last known school holidays are still used. Check the connection or choose another source in the options.

school_holidays_incomplete.title: School holidays for {year} are missing
school_holidays_incomplete.description: School holidays are known until {known_to}. Days without data count as workdays for pupils. The source may not have published next year yet; try again later or add the dates as exceptions.

person_missing.title: Residents without a person
person_missing.description: These residents refer to persons that no longer exist in Home Assistant: {ids}. Their sensors are unavailable. Set their role to "none" or recreate the person.

area_missing.title: Rooms without an area
area_missing.description: These rooms refer to areas that no longer exist in Home Assistant: {ids}. Their sensors are unavailable.
